_comment: Amplifier layer for Different Breed. After a DB post publishes to @dbelitefitness, these accounts amplify it — legit reach, no fake-engagement/ban risk. See skills/amplifier.md. Nothing fires until enabled:true AND at least one target has enabled:true with a connected Upload-Post profile.

collab_coaches._comment: Reference map of coach → IG handle for IG Collab posts (the single biggest legit amplifier — shared engagement pool, both grids). To co-author a post, add e.g. "collaborators": ["dbdonsomerville"] to that post's instagram_options in calendar.json. Handles live in brand-context/coaches-and-staff.md — fill these in as you confirm them.

targets._comment: One entry per amplifier IG account. `profile` is the Upload-Post profile name (created + connected via `node amplify.mjs --connect`). `handle` is just for logging. `reshare` = which formats to push: "story" (recommended), "feed", or both. `first_comment` only applies to feed reshares (stories have no comments). `owner_imessage` powers the rally draft (phone number of whoever owns the account). Set enabled:true once connected.
